notes: Paradigm I (فَعَلَ/يَفْعُلُ). Most common transitive action verbs. First or second radical often a throat letter.
Paradigm II (فَعَلَ/يَفْعِلُ). Common transitive verbs.
Paradigm III (فَعَلَ/يَفْعَلُ). Verbs whose first or second radical is a throat letter (ء ه ع ح غ خ).
Paradigm IV (فَعِلَ/يَفْعَلُ). Stative intransitive verbs. Often yields فَعْلَان adjective.
Paradigm V (فَعُلَ/يَفْعُلُ). Inherent quality verbs. Always intransitive. Masdar on فُعُولَة or فَعَالَة.
Paradigm VI (فَعِلَ/يَفْعِلُ). Very rare paradigm; only a few dozen verbs.
Form II. Causative or intensive of Form I. Gemination of middle radical. Masdar تَفْعِيل (standard), تَفْعِلَة (for مهموز/ناقص), فِعَّال (rare).
Form III. Reciprocal or conative action between two parties. Both مُفَاعَلَة and فِعَال are used simultaneously.
Form IV. Causative. Prefixed hamza. For أجوف verbs masdar becomes إِفَالَة (e.g. إِقَامَة).
Form V. Reflexive of Form II. Imperfect تاء may assimilate to first radical in certain letters.
Form VI. Mutual reciprocal. Reflexive of Form III. Passive imperfect الف becomes واو.
Form VII. Passive/inchoative of Form I. Cannot be formed from verbs whose first radical is يرملون.
Form VIII. Infixed ت after first radical. Assimilation rules: مثال→ تاء doubles; first radical د/ذ/ز→ تاء becomes دال; first radical إطباق→ تاء becomes طاء.
Form IX. Restricted to colors and physical defects. Gemination of final radical.
Form X. To seek/request or consider something as having a quality. For أجوف: masdar becomes اِسْتِفَالَة (e.g. اِسْتِقَامَة).
Form XI. Rare. Intensive color/quality. Long vowel before geminate final radical.
Form XII. Rare. Intensive quality. Infixed واو after first radical.
Form XIII. Very rare. Intensive with doubled واو.
Form XIV. Extremely rare. Assimilation of تاء of Form VIII into first radical.
Form XV. Extremely rare. Assimilation variant of Form VI.
Quadriliteral Form I (also trilateral resembling). Basic action verb with four-consonant root.

مثال يائي. First radical ي. Less common than واوي مثال.
أجوف يائي. Middle ي lengthens to ا in past, returns as ي in present. Masdar فَيْل or فِيَال.
أجوف واوي. Middle و lengthens to ا in past, returns as و in present. Masdar فَوْل or فُوَال.
ناقص واوي. Final و appears as ا in past 3ms, returns as و in present.
ناقص يائي. Final ي appears as ا in past 3ms, returns as ي in present.

لفيف مقرون. Middle و and last ي both weak. Combines أجوف and ناقص rules.
مضاعف. Second and third radicals identical, written as geminate. Masdar فَعْل, فَعَل, or فِعَال.
مهموز الفاء. First radical is hamza. Hamza orthography follows standard rules.
مهموز العين. Middle radical is hamza.

أجوف يائي، فَعَلَ/يَفْعِلُ type. Middle radical ي surfaces as long vowel. Passive: سِيرَ.
أجوف واوي، فَعِلَ/يَفْعَلُ type. Stative. Underlying فَعِلَ but surface past is فَعَلَ due to و→ا.
أجوف يائي، فَعِلَ/يَفْعَلُ type. Stative. Underlying ي→ا in past.
ناقص يائي، فَعَلَ/يَفْعِلُ type. Final ي appears as ى in past, ي in present. Active participle declines as مُنقوص (رامٍ/رامِيًا).
ناقص واوي، فَعَلَ/يَفْعُلُ type. Final و appears as ا in past, و in present. Passive: دُعِيَ (و→ي in passive).
ناقص يائي، فَعِلَ/يَفْعَلُ type. Past ends in يَ, present ends in ى. Stative meaning.

Passive present of ناقص. Final radical appears as ى. Surface: يُرْمَى.
Active participle of Form VIII ناقص. Declines as مُنقوص (-in). E.g. مُقْتَضٍ from اِقْتَضَى.
Passive participle of Form VIII ناقص. Ends in ى (alif maqsura). E.g. مُقْتَضًى.
Active participle of Form V ناقص. Declines as مُنقوص. E.g. مُتَمَنٍّ from تَمَنَّى.
Passive participle of Form V ناقص. Ends in ى. E.g. مُتَمَنًّى.
Active participle of Form X ناقص. Declines as مُنقوص. E.g. مُسْتَدْعٍ from اِسْتَدْعَى.
Passive participle of Form X ناقص. Ends in ى. E.g. مُسْتَدْعًى.
Active participle of Form II ناقص. Declines as مُنقوص. E.g. مُزَكٍّ from زَكَّى.
Passive participle of Form II ناقص. Ends in ى. E.g. مُزَكًّى from زَكَّى.
Active participle of Form III ناقص. Declines as مُنقوص. E.g. مُرَاعٍ from رَاعَى.
Passive participle of Form III ناقص. Ends in ى. E.g. مُرَاعًى from رَاعَى.
Active participle of Form IV ناقص. Declines as مُنقوص. E.g. مُعْطٍ from أَعْطَى.
Passive participle of Form IV ناقص. Ends in ى. E.g. مُعْطًى from أَعْطَى.
Active participle of Form VII ناقص. Declines as مُنقوص. E.g. مُنْقَضٍ from اِنْقَضَى.
Active participle of Form VI ناقص. Declines as مُنقوص. E.g. مُتَدَاعٍ from تَدَاعَى.
Masdar of Form III مضاعف. E.g. مُمَادَّة from مَادَّ. Gemination of third radical.
Masdar of Form IV مضاعف. Same pattern as regular IV but with geminated third radical in root. E.g. إِمْدَاد from أَمَدَّ.
Masdar of Form VI مضاعف. E.g. تَمَادّ from تَمَادَّ. Gemination visible in surface form.
Masdar of Form VII مضاعف. E.g. اِنْشِدَاد from اِنْشَدَّ.
Masdar of Form VIII مضاعف. E.g. اِشْتِدَاد from اِشْتَدَّ.
Masdar of Form X مضاعف. E.g. اِسْتِمْرَار from اِسْتَمَرَّ.
فِعَلَاء pattern. E.g. عِلَمَاء from عَالِم.
فُعَلَى pattern. E.g. حُبَلَى (plural of حُبْلَى).
فِعَالَى pattern. E.g. يَتَامَى from يَتِيم.
فَعَاوِل pattern for أجوف nouns. E.g. قَوَاعِد from قَاعِدَة.
فَيَاعِل pattern for أجوف يائي nouns. E.g. سَيَاسَات (by analogy).
فُعُولَات pattern. Plural of فُعُول plurals. E.g. عُقُولَات.
فِعَالَات pattern. Plural of فِعَال nouns. E.g. رِسَالَات.
فُعَّلَاء pattern. E.g. حُكَّمَاء (variant).
فِعَال as plural (not masdar). E.g. جِبَال from جَبَل.
فُعُل plural pattern. E.g. كُتُب from كِتَاب.
فُعَل plural pattern. E.g. غُرَف from غُرْفَة.
فِعَل plural pattern. E.g. قِطَع from قِطْعَة.
أَفْعُل plural pattern. E.g. أَنْفُس from نَفْس.
فَعِيل as broken plural. E.g. كَرِيم → كِرَام (by shift).
فُعَلَاء rare plural. E.g. أُمَنَاء from أَمِين.
فَعَالِيَة pattern. E.g. عَبَاقِرَة from عَبْقَرِيّ.
فَعَاوِيل pattern. E.g. عَصَافِير from عُصْفُور.
Feminine of أَفْعَل color/defect adjective. Diptote. E.g. حَمْرَاء from أَحْمَر.
Feminine form of فَعِيل adjective. E.g. كَرِيمَة from كَرِيم.
Abstract noun pattern denoting effectiveness/productivity. Modern Arabic. E.g. فَعَّالِيَّة (effectiveness).
Abstract noun from passive participle + ية. Denotes the state of being acted upon.
Abstract noun from active participle + ية. Denotes agency or effectiveness.
Abstract noun pattern. Rare. Derived from فُعَال nouns.
Abstract noun from فِعَال nouns + ية. E.g. كِتَابِيَّة (literariness).
مهموز العين (hamza as second radical). Hamza follows standard orthographic rules.
مهموز اللام (hamza as third radical). Hamza seat changes based on surrounding vowels.
مهموز الفاء (hamza as first radical). Imperative: كُلْ (hamza drops). Active participle: آكِل (hamza+alif→madda).
Quinqueliteral (خماسي) noun pattern. E.g. سَفَرْجَل (quince).
Quinqueliteral reduplicated pattern. E.g. صَمَحْمَح (strong man).
Six-consonant noun pattern. E.g. عَنْدَلِيب (nightingale).
Rare pattern with geminate third radical and defective ending. E.g. هِجِرَّى.
Pattern فُعَالَى. E.g. سُكَارَى (drunkards — plural/adjective).
Masdar mimi for أجوف verbs. E.g. مَسِير from سَارَ. Also functions as place/time noun.
Place/time noun for ناقص يائي verbs.
Relative adjective from plural-base nouns. E.g. عَرَاقِيّ from عِرَاق.
Relative adjective from broken plural base. E.g. دُوَلِيّ from دُوَل (plural of دَوْلَة).
Form II with hamza as third radical. Masdar: تَهْيِئَة. Hamza seat follows vowel harmony.
Form X أجوف. Middle radical surfaces as long vowel. Masdar: اِسْتِقَامَة (اِسْتِفَالَة pattern).
Rare broken plural pattern فِعَالَة. E.g. حِجَارَة from حَجَر (stone). Ends in ة which here is not a feminine marker but a plural marker.
Form I masdar pattern فَعَال. Common for speech/sound verbs. E.g. كَلَام (speech), سَلَام (peace), جَمَال (beauty).
Form I masdar/noun pattern فُعْلَة. E.g. غُرْفَة (room/handful), لُقْمَة (morsel). Also functions as noun of instance.
Passive participle of Form VII. Theoretically مُنْفَعَل but Form VII is inherently intransitive/inchoative so passive use is extremely rare. Attested in some classical texts as adjectival.
Form IX has no true passive participle (always intransitive). مُفْعَلّ functions as both active and stative participle. E.g. مُحْمَرّ (reddened).
Active participle of Form XI (اِفْعَالَّ). Intensive color/quality. E.g. مُحْمَارّ (intensely reddening). Form XI is intransitive so no passive participle.
Active participle of Form XII (اِفْعَوْعَلَ). E.g. مُخْشَوْشِن. Form XII is intransitive so no passive participle.
Active participle of Form XIII (اِفْعَوَّلَ). Very rare. Form XIII is intransitive so no passive participle.
Passive participle of Form Q-II (تَفَعْلَلَ). Rare since Q-II is typically reflexive/intransitive. E.g. مُتَدَحْرَج.
Active participle of Form Q-III (اِفْعَلَلَّ). E.g. مُطْمَئِنّ (tranquil). Form Q-III is intransitive so no passive participle.
Active participle of Form Q-IV (اِفْعَنْلَلَ). Very rare. E.g. مُحْرَنْجِم. Form Q-IV is intransitive so no passive participle.
